items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Let me ask you this: you heard those recordings of Bird with Jay McShann... [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: That’s right. So maybe that was the reason why that that went down that way, for the impact that it would have if it was suddenly thrust upon people. Because I know my father came home with a record of Bird, and he said, “Look how sharp you think you can play. Listen to this.” Of course, Bird just turned me around.
This was the Jay McShann stuff?
Yeah. But I first heard it, “Is that Lester Young playing alto or something?” He says no. But that’s the way I perceived Bird when I first heard him.
